plan.name: Close configured repository check gaps
plan.summary: Run factory scope before looking for a plumbing plan: an in-bounds modeled change gets ordinary part checks, a plumbing change retains all native plan and ratification checks, and out-of-bounds changes fail, preserving #736's pinned tests and generated branch arguments. Following #740's F1-A answer, ordinary checks prepare the selected parts from committed candidate dependency inputs and lockfiles under the base contract's ownership, images, install commands and existing admission rules, cache by those inputs, and run captured checks offline; native plumbing plans retain their captured-input validation. Stage each committed tree through one hardened git cat-file --batch process, validating responses and retaining file modes and staging refusals, and give host tree removal its own fresh two-minute reserve after the unchanged fifteen-second container shutdown reserve, awaiting cleanup and still failing actual cleanup errors, timeouts and interrupted checks. Configured preflight must recognize quoted and spaced keys and refuse disabling job conditions, nonempty or uncertain needs, and missing, filtered or uncertain pull_request triggers, while requiring a literal push trigger, preserving the generated main-branch push filter, custom surrounding steps and legacy modeled-only setup. Update SPEC.md with existing decision citations, README.md's factory-branch guidance and docs/factory.md's CI, dependency and cleanup descriptions; the merger records F1-A and these refinements to D-0305, D-0311 and D-0395 because plumbing cannot write the decision journal, and external intake remains disabled.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate740ModeledFactory
tests.says: Scope runs before plan loading: configured modeled factory changes run the captured checks for their owners without a plumbing plan or plumbing ratification lookup, while a missing plumbing plan, invalid modeled scope and command failures still fail. The generated workflow and #736's pinned acceptance files stay unchanged.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate740CandidateDependencies
tests.says: Ordinary Go, Python and npm dependency updates install the committed candidate's declared inputs under base commands and pinned images, then check offline against that same graph. Changed bytes get a distinct verified preparation, identical bytes reuse it across commits, dirty inputs and candidate configuration supply no authority, and ratified plumbing still refuses changed captured inputs.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate740DependencyAdmission
tests.says: Every selected candidate dependency graph is admitted before any installation: missing or inconsistent locks, unlocked Python requirements, unsupported Go replacements and npm local artifacts fail with an explanation and no external execution, even if candidate configuration tries to remove the checks.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate740BatchStaging
tests.says: Staging many committed blobs starts exactly one cat-file --batch process per tree, preserves every byte and executable mode despite dirty files and archive attributes, and removes both staged trees before cleanup returns.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate740BatchFailures
tests.says: A batch reader refuses mismatched object identities, wrong types, malformed lengths, truncated bodies, missing terminators and unsuccessful object-process exit; cancellation also fails staging.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate740IndependentTreeCleanup
tests.says: Host staging removal has an independent bounded reserve even after the container shutdown context expires: it completes before returning, removes links without touching their targets, and reports filesystem errors. Container, execution and cleanup failures remain failures, and queue slots remain held through cleanup.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate740Preflight
tests.says: Configured setup refuses quoted or spaced disabling job keys, nonempty or uncertain needs and missing, filtered or uncertain PR triggers with upgrade guidance. It accepts the generated workflow, literal unfiltered PR/push triggers and harmless customization, and keeps legacy modeled-only preflight compatible without executing workflow scripts.

usage.summary: Wrote plan.json and seven acceptance tests covering all of #740 in one pull request, leaving repo/ unchanged. The first check passed: all seven tests fail on the base code as required.
